problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 10 delivery routes through 10 specialized checkpoints.

Each route consists of a sequence of checkpoint visits represented as pairs (Checkpoint, Processing duration),
where each pair specifies the checkpoint that must be visited and the time required for processing.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the checkpoints must be visited.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (C9, 2) → (C7, 9) → (C4, 7) → (C6, 2) → (C10, 9) → (C1, 1) → (C3, 5) → (C8, 6) → (C5, 6) → (C2, 1)
* R2 requires the sequence: (C8, 10) → (C3, 9) → (C1, 4) → (C5, 5) → (C6, 3) → (C7, 4) → (C4, 4) → (C2, 8) → (C9, 4) → (C10, 4)
* R3 requires the sequence: (C5, 4) → (C6, 10) → (C4, 10) → (C10, 4) → (C9, 7) → (C3, 3) → (C2, 8) → (C1, 5) → (C8, 10) → (C7, 2)
* R4 requires the sequence: (C2, 8) → (C5, 7) → (C4, 5) → (C1, 4) → (C7, 9) → (C3, 6) → (C6, 9) → (C10, 10) → (C9, 2) → (C8, 6)
* R5 requires the sequence: (C7, 5) → (C6, 9) → (C2, 3) → (C5, 3) → (C8, 2) → (C10, 3) → (C4, 2) → (C3, 5) → (C9, 1) → (C1, 4)
* R6 requires the sequence: (C9, 1) → (C6, 7) → (C7, 7) → (C5, 10) → (C3, 9) → (C1, 9) → (C4, 4) → (C8, 2) → (C10, 2) → (C2, 6)
* R7 requires the sequence: (C7, 6) → (C9, 2) → (C5, 1) → (C6, 6) → (C2, 6) → (C4, 8) → (C8, 3) → (C1, 9) → (C10, 5) → (C3, 1)
* R8 requires the sequence: (C2, 9) → (C8, 3) → (C3, 8) → (C7, 1) → (C4, 2) → (C9, 9) → (C10, 6) → (C1, 6) → (C5, 7) → (C6, 6)
* R9 requires the sequence: (C4, 1) → (C2, 6) → (C7, 9) → (C8, 8) → (C6, 2) → (C10, 9) → (C1, 5) → (C3, 2) → (C9, 10) → (C5, 6)
* R10 requires the sequence: (C1, 9) → (C3, 1) → (C5, 6) → (C6, 6) → (C2, 10) → (C9, 8) → (C4, 4) → (C10, 8) → (C7, 7) → (C8, 10)

Each checkpoint processing must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,
and each checkpoint can only handle one delivery route at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all route operations at the checkpoints
so that the total completion time for all delivery routes is minimized.
